ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Section G: Writing the Y oung Adult and Middle Grade Novel In this workshop, we?ll be writing for both Young Adults (ages 12 and up) and the Middle Grade crowd (ages 8-12). We?ll embark upon the long and lovely process of writing a full-length novel for these demographics, with plenty of discussion about planning, process, and market appeal. We?ll also read and discuss literature for those age groups?from Harry Potter to the Hunger Games, from John Green to Kate DiCamillo?to help inform our own writing as we seek to create quality literature for younger readers.
